title: Lokalized generated CLDR locale data
description: Language-neutral locale tables generated by CldrDataGenerator from SHA-pinned CLDR inputs. Consumed by every Lokalized implementation. Serialized as RFC 8785 JCS: object members sorted by UTF-16 code unit, no insignificant whitespace, no trailing newline.
$comment: Plan v7 section 5.1. Likely-subtag rows retain complete language-script-region triples; row absence and a present Latn row are distinct, and preferredRegionAlias reads the maximized region. No component may be projected away in this artifact.

formatVersion.description: Incremented only for a breaking change to this artifact's shape.

aliases.description: CLDR alias replacements, applied in the six-step order documented in plan section 2.1.

likelySubtags.description: Full language-script-region triples. The `to` value is a maximized tag; consumers read its language, script and region components, and row presence itself is behavioral.

parentLocales.description: Explicit CLDR parent locales. These are not subtag truncation: 198 of 199 rows differ from stripping the last subtag, and `root` is a stop sentinel rather than a candidate.

validity.description: Valid subtags. Read at runtime by the single-locale matcher via isKnownLanguageTag, and by the Node directory loader for filename validation.

cldrVersion.description: The pinned Unicode CLDR release these tables were generated from.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or UN M.49 numeric region code.

pairList.$comment: Array order is schema-significant: it is generator order and is never re-sorted. Keys are not asserted unique here because alias tables legitimately map several sources to one target.
